name: 折返しラベルを含む一般設定セクション
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0004 折返しラベルを含む一般設定セクション.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact six-row general settings section, original region x16,y526,w358,h302 normalized (pixel48,1590,1082,913), with the original icon anatomy. Japanese text only, verbatim: heading 一般; rows 標準のアプリ / ショートカット / スクロール中は下部の
ナビゲーションを隠す / データの使用量 / プライバシー / ライトハウスについて. Keep the third label on TWO lines and retain switch at right. Existing typography Meiryo Regular logical12/16 for heading,14/24 for labels, tracking0. Correct the mock's substituted icons using ORIGINAL: row1 nine dots in3x3 app grid; row2 upward/right-pointing curved shortcut arrow; row3 rectangular screen outline with horizontal bottom bar; row4 circular data-usage ring with small missing wedge/marked upper-right arc; row5 shield outline with quartered fill details; row6 lowercase information i in circle. Do NOT use the mock's gear, swap arrows, repeated document icons or question mark. Source glyphs remain white on equal slate #526173 rounded tiles. Small light-neutral chevrons on rows1,2,4,5,6. Row3 has ON switch with forest-green gradient track, white circular thumb at RIGHT, aligned without overlap. White rounded group, fine inset dividers start at label column, subtle neutral border and soft shadow; pure-white outer canvas. Preserve compact logical358px-wide composition and extra row3 height for2 lines. Scale uniformly into around1400x1400 readable render with restrained margin. No phone chrome, new rows or extra labels.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Use consistent slate supporting tiles because group meaning is already conveyed by one General section; retain the real enabled-state accent as forest-green ON switch with right thumb. Preserve original icon anatomy; no random purple or blue tile colors.
reviewNotes: 原版全体/対象cropとmockを目視し、原版優先で6glyphを再構成。青いONは森緑、補助tileはslate。生成後に日本語6項目と2行ラベル、ON、grid/画面/ring/shield/infoを確認。要修正:不要な外側カードが加わり二重枠になった。ショートカット矢印は原版の上向きカーブより一般的な右矢印になり細部差あり。全バージョン保持して対象修正予定。操作/native/所有者承認なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
